prompt: At the time of the END of the 2016 French Open, what was the head-to-head between the Men's World No. 1 at that time, and the runner-up of that year's Australian Open in the Men's Singles category?
answer:
At the end of the 2016 French Open, **Novak Djokovic led Andy Murray 24–10 in their career head-to-head**.

Djokovic entered the French Open final leading **23–10** and then defeated Murray in the final, 3–6, 6–1, 6–2, 6–4.
